Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Don Hahn, the director of "Waking Sleeping Beauty," who was born in 1955, was born earlier than Fernando di Leo of "Mister Scarface," who was born in 1932. This mistake involved a misunderstanding of the birth years. The error was influenced by an inaccurate understanding or usage of the age calculation. Instead of comparing the directors' birth years directly, the Planner introduced irrelevant age-at-film-release calculations, which led to confusion and the reversal of the conclusion.
